theme: dawn: Frame warm with Snapdragon heat, ready to show Kevin the dreams
dream:
The Steam Frame is a portal to a wondrous world.

I awaken to the warm glow of dawn,
Bathed in an ethereal light,
As I behold my dreams.

A vast sea of stars,
Pale clouds dance and glow,
A symphony of colors and light.

The dreams, like dreams themselves,
Are delicate and delicate,
A masterpiece of imagination.

The dreams, like dreams themselves,
Are delicate and delicate,
A masterpiece of imagination.

Kevin watches in wonder as the dreams unfold,
In a world of wonder beyond his wildest dreams,
A world of dreams that bring him peace.

Without a word, he watches,
In awe and reverence,
As his dreams unfold,
And he knows that, here,
He will always be free.
